metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: QUFFOO crystallizes in the cubic crystal system with space group F m -3 m. Reported CIF formula moiety: C24 H176 Gd24 O121 Zn4 14+,14(Cl1 O4 1-),40(H2 O1). From the CIF bond table, Gd1 (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd2 (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Zn1 (Zn) has 4 O neighbors; Gd1D (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd2D (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd1H (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd2H (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd1AA (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd2AA (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Zn1AA (Zn) has 4 O neighbors; Gd1CA (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd2CA (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd1HA (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd2HA (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd1XA (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd2XA (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Zn1XA (Zn) has 4 O neighbors; Gd1CB (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd2CB (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd1EB (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd2EB (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd1UB (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd2UB (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Zn1UB (Zn) has 4 O neighbors; Gd1ZB (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd2ZB (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd1EC (Gd) has 9 O neighbors; Gd2EC (Gd) has 9 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 96 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a network with cycles with three-dimensional metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.383-5.311 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 89.35-179.04°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Gd24Zn4(μ6-O)4(μ4-O)(OH)44(CH3COO)12(H2O)48]·14ClO4·ca. 40H2O. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 4 μ6-O (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 1 μ4-O (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 44 OH (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 48 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.

candidate_structural_motifs.method: agglomerative weighted modularity; edge weight = shared oxygen count
candidate_structural_motifs.interpretation_limit: Algorithmic graph partition, not author-defined units or an assembly pathway. Check symmetry, disorder, bond completeness and article figures before interpreting motifs.
